why: exact: measured stable on linux-x86-64 -- two complete matrix runs on 2026-11-06 gave identical values for every key, and three earlier runs that day agreed on every count. Comet with 4 threads writes byte-identical PINs run to run (measured) and Percolator with --seed 1 byte-identical tables, so nothing these values derive from varies on one platform. PSM identifiers are compared without the run directory Comet prefixes them with (the -N path the product passes). Exact equality is per platform: another platform's build could round a score differently, which is why the platform is part of the key and a new platform adds goldens rather than tolerances
